mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report ( reporter_id, post_id, comment_id, reason, detail ) VALUES ( #{reporterId}, #{postId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{commentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{reason}, #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT author_id AS authorId, is_secret AS secret, secret_password_hash AS secretPasswordHash, comments_locked AS commentsLocked, blinded_at AS blindedAt FROM post WHERE id = #{postId} AND board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
SELECT author_id FROM comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND blinded_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
mapper.sql: FROM report r LEFT JOIN comment c ON c.id = r.comment_id INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = COALESCE(r.post_id, c.post_id) INNER JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id INNER JOIN member reporter ON reporter.id = r.reporter_id
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, p.id AS postId, r.comment_id AS commentId, b.slug AS boardSlug, b.name AS boardName, b.status AS boardStatus, p.title AS postTitle, reporter.display_name AS reporterDisplayName, r.reason, r.status, p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS postDeleted, c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS commentDeleted, r.created_at AS createdAt
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.id, r.reporter_id AS reporterId, reporter.display_name AS reporterDisplayName, p.id AS postId, r.comment_id AS commentId, b.slug AS boardSlug, b.name AS boardName, b.status AS boardStatus, p.title AS postTitle, author.id AS authorId, author.display_name AS authorDisplayName, r.reason, r.detail, r.status, CASE WHEN r.comment_id IS NULL THEN p.content ELSE c.content END AS content, CASE WHEN r.comment_id IS NULL THEN p.content_document ELSE NULL END AS contentDocument, CASE WHEN r.comment_id IS NULL THEN p.created_at ELSE c.created_at END AS contentCreatedAt, CASE WHEN r.comment_id IS NULL THEN p.updated_at ELSE c.updated_at END AS contentUpdatedAt, p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS postDeleted, c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS commentDeleted, r.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, reviewer.display_name AS reviewerDisplayName, r.review_note AS reviewNote, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, (p.blinded_at IS NOT NULL) AS postBlinded, (c.blinded_at IS NOT NULL) AS commentBlinded, CASE WHEN r.comment_id IS NULL THEN p.version ELSE c.version END AS targetVersion
INNER JOIN member author ON author.id = CASE WHEN r.comment_id IS NULL THEN p.author_id ELSE c.author_id END LEFT JOIN member reviewer ON reviewer.id = r.reviewed_by WHERE r.id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewed_by = #{adminId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND #{status} IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
